definitions.explanation: Easy to mistake for something else; causing confusion due to similarity.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紛|まぎ}らわしい。
examples.english: These two kanji are easily confused.

examples.japanese: {紛|まぎ}らわしい⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{駅名|えきめい}→駅名：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{紛|まぎ}らわしくて、⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦{降|お}りて→降りる：00568_oriru⟧⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: The station names were confusing, and I got off at the wrong stop.

examples.japanese: {紛|まぎ}らわしい⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧。

notes:
{紛|まぎ}らわしい is an i-adjective derived from the verb ⟦{紛|まぎ}れる→紛れる：07572_magireru⟧ (to be mixed up, to be mistaken).

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {紛|まぎ}らわしく
- Noun form: {紛|まぎ}らわしさ

COMMON PATTERNS:
Often used for things that look or sound similar enough to cause confusion:
- Similar kanji or words
- Ambiguous statements
- Look-alike products or places

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紛|まぎ}らわしい⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧ - ambiguous/misleading expression
- {紛|まぎ}らわしい⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧ - confusing way of saying
- {紛|まぎ}らわしい⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧ - confusing names

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {紛|まぎ}らわしい vs. ⟦{曖昧|あいまい}→曖昧：08051_aimai⟧: {紛|まぎ}らわしい emphasizes potential for confusion with something else; ⟦{曖昧|あいまい}→曖昧：08051_aimai⟧ means vague or unclear in general
- {紛|まぎ}らわしい vs. ⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦にくい→にくい：02005_nikui⟧: {紛|まぎ}らわしい implies similarity causing confusion; ⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦にくい→にくい：02005_nikui⟧ just means hard to understand
